correctness.rationale: For constant a>0 and an even periodic uniform P1 DG mesh, the exact weak-form operators are F_A=-(a/dx)(A+B-A_- -B_-), F_B=(3a/dx)(A-B-A_- -B_-), and G_A=-2aB/dx, G_B=0. Every explicit two-stage order-two tableau reduces to I+dt F+(dt^2/2)FG. On alternating cells, M_nu=[[1-2nu,-2nu+2nu^2],[6nu,1-6nu^2]]. With W=diag(1,1/3), the energy decrement Q=W-M^TWM has determinant -4nu^4 for all nu>0; it has a negative direction, proving no positive globally nonexpansive CFL for any even mesh. Independently recomputed M,Q, det and rational vector (A,B)=(3/20,1) giving negative decrement -7/5000 at nu=1/10, plus generalized-eigenvalue amplification 1+(sqrt(T^2+48nu^4)-T)/2 with leading excess 3nu^3. This does not prove eigenvalue instability or anything about corrected schemes.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge O PASS for the exact unconditional one-step L2 energy obstruction and sharp alternating-mode amplification, not for inventing cRKDG. Chen–Sun–Xing establish the compact-stage method and Fourier/eigenvalue stability, a different property from physical W-contraction. Sun 2026 proves weak cell-average entropy inequalities and corrected strong entropy, not the uncorrected whole-P1 energy determinant. Liu–Jiang–Zhang discuss standard RKDG entropy obstructions and compact corrections under different discretization/conditions. A specialized filtered or Lax–Wendroff DG source not fully accessible could overlap.
residual_risks: Full published derivations of the 2024 cRKDG or 2026 entropy papers were not accessible; possible overlapping inner-mode calculation cannot be excluded.
Even mesh, degree-one, no limiter/correction, physical upwind flux and fixed positive Courant are essential; the claim does not cover odd meshes, spectral-radius instability, or nonlinear fluxes.

value.rationale: The sharp all-positive-CFL counterexample isolates a structural energy-stability limitation of a widely used compact RKDG construction. It distinguishes spectral-radius stability and weak cell-average entropy from norm monotonicity of the full polynomial, and supplies an exact obstruction with quantitative small-step growth. This is a motivated numerical-analysis boundary, not an arbitrary tiny negative test.
